name: signalbox
description: A live circuit board beside the chat: Claude sits in the middle, its tools are pins that light up as they are used, and file and shell work is wired into a release track read from git. Switches between a tall and a wide layout by itself.

trunkBranch.title: Trunk branch
trunkBranch.description: The branch your work is measured against, such as main, master or develop. Left empty, Signalbox asks the remote which branch is its default and falls back to main or master.
